summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Lead Real Estate Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, furnishing its interim report for the six months ended December 31, 2025 under Rule 13a-16. The filing contains unaudited consolidated balance sheets and statements of comprehensive loss, reporting a net loss of ¥446.8M for the period. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, disposition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situations event. This is a routine earnings update, equivalent to an interim financial statement submission under US reporting obligations, and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
